bullets.text: Kaynes plans $1bn incremental OSAT investment under ISM 2.0, 3x its ISM 1.0 outlay, per JPM's Semicon takeaways.
bullets.source: JPM - India EMS: Kaynes planning $1bn OSAT investment under ISM 2.0

detail.summary: Kaynes plans a $1bn incremental OSAT investment (advanced packaging, LED/micro-LED) under ISM 2.0, 3x its ISM 1.0 outlay, if approved. Funding is the open question as it scales from 2.3bn to 8bn chips annually.
points: $1bn incremental OSAT investment planned, 3x ISM 1.0 outlay
FY27 OSAT revenue guide Rs2.5-3bn; Rs1bn already booked
Capacity target scales 2.3bn to 8bn chips annually

bullets.text: Kaynes OSAT unit 2 (1.2bn chips/yr, Fujitsu & Infineon) up for client qualification end-Nov/early-Dec, then commercial output.
bullets.source: JPM - India EMS: Kaynes planning $1bn OSAT investment under ISM 2.0

detail.summary: Unit 2, at 1.2bn chips/yr for Fujitsu and Infineon, heads for client qualification by end-November or early December, with commercial production to follow. Unit 1 (3.6mn chips/yr, Alpha Omega Semiconductor) is already in commercial production.
points: Unit 1: 3.6mn chips/yr already live, client Alpha Omega

bullets.text: LTTS EBIT margin fell 18.5% (FY23) to 14% (FY26E); JPM presses the path back to its 16.5% target by 4QFY27.
bullets.source: JPM - JPM India Conference: Key points of discussion with LTTS

detail.summary: JPM's pre-meeting note frames the LTTS debate as whether margin has bottomed and whether organic growth can return to mid-to-high teens after two straight years at 3%.
points: 18.5% FY23 EBIT margin down to 14% FY26E
Two large deals absorbed: SWC, Intelliswift

bullets.text: KPIT onshore mix leads peers at 50% (LTTS 45%, Tata Elxsi 25%); JPM probes recovery toward 20-21% normalised EBITDA.
bullets.source: JPM - JPM India Conference: Key points of discussion with KPIT

detail.summary: JPM frames KPIT's near-term debate as recovering margin after sharp 1Q headwinds and converting deal wins into revenue, citing EV-slowdown drag at top clients BMW, Honda and VW.
points: Onshore mix 50% vs LTTS 45%, Tata Elxsi 25%
Headwinds named at BMW, Honda, VW

points: Coforge sole India name among 13 situations listed
